offers.description: Free furniture quote with 1 business day turnaround. OECM pre-tendered pricing available for eligible Ontario public sector organizations.

mainEntity.name: What do you need from me to start a quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: Anything is a starting point — a list of products, a room dimension, a headcount, or links to items you’ve seen on the site. You don’t need a finished floor plan or a confirmed budget to get numbers. We’ll ask a few follow-up questions if needed and get you an itemised quote, usually within one business day.

mainEntity.name: Is there a minimum order to get a quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: No minimum. We quote single chairs, full boardrooms, and everything in between. For very small orders (one or two items), the online store lets you purchase directly — the quote channel is most useful when you want product guidance, a free space plan, or OECM-formatted pricing.

mainEntity.name: I’m an OECM buyer. What do I include in my quote request?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mention that you’re purchasing under OECM and include your organisation’s OECM member number. Brant Business Interiors holds Agreement 2025-470 in the office furniture category. We’ll format the quote against pre-tendered pricing and flag which line items are OECM-eligible so your purchasing team can approve it cleanly — no extra steps on your end.Not sure if your organisation is OECM-eligible? See our OECM overview or call 1-800-835-9565 and we’ll confirm in five minutes.

mainEntity.name: Do you include delivery and installation in quotes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — all quotes include delivery and installation as a separate line item so you can see the full landed cost. We deliver across Ontario and can install with our own crew. After-hours and weekend installs are available for occupied spaces. For out-of-province shipments, call us for a freight quote.

mainEntity.name: Can I pay by purchase order (PO)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Government bodies, school boards, hospitals, non-profits, and established businesses can place orders on account with a PO. Mention this when you request your quote and we’ll set up your account during the quoting process.
